hero.name: Leandro Trabucco
hero.roleValue: QA Specialist · Co-founder at JLRT Software

about.title: Full Stack Developer & QA
bio: I test software, design MVPs, and build full-stack apps, from concept to production.
I co-founded JLRT Software, a small software company in Córdoba, where we build the systems our clients run their businesses on. By day I'm the QA Specialist for a US payroll and staffing platform.
Years in hospitality in Japan taught me to obsess over user experience and ship for real people.

items.summary: Two-year program (1,375 hours) taken alongside my work: Programming I–IV, Databases I–II, Systems Architecture & Operating Systems, Software Development Management and Statistics. Adds academic grounding to what I already build and test in production.

Intensive 9-week full-stack program in Tokyo, covering Ruby on Rails, JavaScript, relational databases, REST APIs, and LLM integration. Pair programming, code reviews, and project-based learning from day one. The final two weeks were a team-built capstone, [Nihongo Hero](https://github.com/LeoCba07/Nihongo-Hero), a mobile-first web app where I was the largest contributor on a four-person team.

items.title: Jidou Navi
items.description: Crowdsourced mobile app for discovering Japan's unique vending machines, with an interactive map and gamified check-ins. Lead developer: built most of the app, with early help from a development partner. Now live on the Google Play Store.

items.title: El Alto
items.description: Cabin rental website for a 30-year-old family business in Argentina. Its contact form and chatbot pre-fill WhatsApp with dates and guest count, since the owners estimated about 80% of inquiries arrived without them.

items.title: Calibr.ar
items.description: Workshop management SaaS for Argentine auto repair shops: repair orders, quotes, inventory, vehicles and scheduling in one place. Built at JLRT Software, where I designed the interface and design system and built many of its screens. Live in production.

items.title: Agile
items.description: Point-of-sale system for Argentine kiosks that keeps selling when the internet drops, with two tills, wholesale orders and the shop's numbers on the owner's phone. Built at JLRT Software: I built much of the admin app and the till, and ran the scenario-based test sessions before releases.
